description:
At the beginning of your end step, Toph triggers, causing Mindslaver to become an artifact land creature.
Activate Mindslaver by paying {4}, tapping and sacrificing it.
Toph triggers, returning Mindslaver from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Mindslaver ability, causing you to gain control of an opponent during their next turn.
Repeat during each of your turns.
